arxiv-2007-05740.title: Enhanced Behavioral Cloning Based self-driving Car Using Transfer Learning
arxiv-2007-05740.creator: Uppala Sumanth, Narinder Singh Punn, Sanjay Kumar Sonbhadra, Sonali Agarwal
arxiv-2007-05740.description: Abstract With the growing phase of artificial intelligence and autonomous learning, the self-driving car is one of the promising area of research and emerging as a center of focus for automobile industries. Behavioral cloning is the process of replicating human behavior via visuomotor policies by means of machine learning algorithms.

arxiv-2102-01199.title: Causal Inference with the Instrumental Variable Approach and Bayesian Nonparametric Machine Learning
arxiv-2102-01199.creator: Robert McCulloch, Rodney Sparapani, Brent Logan, Purushottam Laud
arxiv-2102-01199.description: Abstract We provide a new flexible framework for inference with the instrumental variable model. Rather than using linear specifications, functions characterizing the effects of instruments and other explanatory variables are estimated using machine learning via Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART). Error terms and their distribution are inferred using Dirichlet Process mixtures.

arxiv-2104-06387.title: ExplainaBoard : An Explainable Leaderboard for NLP
arxiv-2104-06387.creator: Pengfei Liu, Jinlan Fu, Yang Xiao, Weizhe Yuan, Shuaichen Chang, Junqi Dai, Yixin Liu, Zihuiwen Ye, Zi-Yi Dou, Graham Neubig
arxiv-2104-06387.description: Abstract With the rapid development of NLP research, leaderboards have emerged as one tool to track the performance of various systems on various NLP tasks. They are effective in this goal to some extent, but generally present a rather simplistic one-dimensional view of the submitted systems, communicated only through holistic accuracy numbers.

arxiv-2205-04273.title: Diffstar: A Fully Parametric Physical Model for Galaxy Assembly History 2022 Diffstar: A Fully Parametric Physical Model for Galaxy Assembly History – B
arxiv-2205-04273.creator: Alex Alarcon, Andrew P. Hearin, Matthew R. Becker, Jonás Chaves-Montero
arxiv-2205-04273.description: Abstract We present Diffstar, a smooth parametric model for the in-situ star formation history (SFH) of galaxies. Diffstar is distinct from conventional SFH models that are used to interpret the spectral energy distribution (SED) of an observed galaxy, because our model is parametrized directly in terms of basic features of galaxy formation physics.

arxiv-2210-04143.title: Strong Gravitational Lensing Parameter Estimation with Vision Transformer
arxiv-2210-04143.creator: Kuan-Wei Huang, Geoff Chih-Fan Chen, Po-Wen Chang, Sheng-Chieh Lin, Chia-Jung Hsu, Vishal Thengane, Joshua Yao-Yu Lin
arxiv-2210-04143.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kuan-Wei Huang, Geoff Chih-Fan Chen, Po-Wen Chang, Sheng-Chieh Lin, Chia-Jung Hsu, Vishal Thengane, Joshua Yao-Yu Lin. Quantifying the parameters and corresponding uncertainties of hundreds of strongly lensed quasar systems holds the key to resolving one of the most important scientific questions: the Hubble constant ( H 0 H_{0} ) tension.

arxiv-2307-02971.title: On the Cultural Gap in Text-to-Image Generation
arxiv-2307-02971.creator: Bingshuai Liu, Longyue Wang, * Chenyang Lyu, Yong Zhang, Jinsong Su, Shuming Shi, Zhaopeng Tu
arxiv-2307-02971.description: Abstract One challenge in text-to-image (T2I) generation is the inadvertent reflection of culture gaps present in the training data, which signifies the disparity in generated image quality when the cultural elements of the input text are rarely collected in the training set.

arxiv-2309-06717.title: Bias Amplification Enhances Minority Group Performance
arxiv-2309-06717.creator: Gaotang Li gaotang@umich.edu, Jiarui Liu jiaruil5@cs.cmu.edu, Wei Hu vvh@umich.edu
arxiv-2309-06717.description: Abstract Neural networks produced by standard training are known to suffer from poor accuracy on rare subgroups despite achieving high accuracy on average, due to the correlations between certain spurious features and labels. Previous approaches based on worst-group loss minimization ( e.g. Group-DRO) are effective in improving worse-group accuracy but require expensive group annotations for all the training samples.

arxiv-2311-03942.title: The Music Meta Ontology: a flexible semantic model for the interoperability of music metadata
arxiv-2311-03942.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . The semantic description of music metadata is a key requirement for the creation of music datasets that can be aligned, integrated, and accessed for information retrieval and knowledge discovery. It is nonetheless an open challenge due to the complexity of musical concepts arising from different genres, styles, and periods – standing to benefit from a lingua franca to accommodate various stakeholders (musicologists, librarians, data engineers, etc.).

arxiv-2402-11199.title: Direct Evaluation of Chain-of-Thought in Multi-hop Reasoning with Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2402-11199.creator: Minh-Vuong Nguyen Linhao Luo Fatemeh Shiri Dinh Phung, Yuan-Fang Li Thuy-Trang Vu Gholamreza Haffari
arxiv-2402-11199.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning abilities when prompted to generate chain-of-thought (CoT) explanations alongside answers. However, previous research on evaluating LLMs has solely focused on answer accuracy, neglecting the correctness of the generated CoT. In this paper, we delve deeper into the CoT reasoning capabilities of LLMs in multi-hop question answering by utilizing knowledge graphs (KGs).

arxiv-2507-22979.title: Thick-to-thin disc transition and gas disc shrinking induced by the Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus merger 20262025 Thick-to-thin disc transition and gas disc shrinking induced by the Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus merger – 8
arxiv-2507-22979.creator: Natsuki Funakoshi, Daisuke Kawata, Jason L. Sanders, Ioana Ciucă, Robert J. J. Grand, HanYuan Zhāng
arxiv-2507-22979.description: Abstract Understanding the Milky Way disc formation requires characterising its structural and kinematic properties as functions of stellar age. Using red giant stars from APOGEE DR17 and Gaia DR3, we model the age-dependent stellar kinematics with a quasi-isothermal distribution function and fit disc parameters as a function of age using non-parametric splines.

arxiv-2509-11355.title: Promoting Shape Bias in CNNs: Frequency-Based and Contrastive Regularization for Corruption Robustness
arxiv-2509-11355.creator: Robin Narsingh Ranabhat, Longwei Wang, Amit Kumar Patel, KC santosh
arxiv-2509-11355.description: Abstract Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) excel at image classification but remain vulnerable to common corruptions that humans handle with ease. A key reason for this fragility is their reliance on local texture cues rather than global object shapes—a stark contrast to human perception. To address this, we propose two complementary regularization strategies designed to encourage shape-biased representations and enhance robustness.

arxiv-2509-19636.title: Minimalistic Autonomous Stack for High-Speed Time-Trial Racing
arxiv-2509-19636.creator: Mahmoud Ali, Hassan Jardali, Youwei Yu, Durgakant Pushp, Lantao Liu
arxiv-2509-19636.description: Abstract Autonomous racing has seen significant advancements, driven by competitions such as the Indy Autonomous Challenge (IAC) and the Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL). However, developing an autonomous racing stack for a full-scale car is often constrained by limited access to dedicated test tracks, restricting opportunities for real-world validation.

arxiv-2601-05199.title: Approximation theory for distant Bang calculus
arxiv-2601-05199.creator: Kostia Chardonnet, Jules Chouquet, Axel Kerinec
arxiv-2601-05199.description: Abstract Approximation semantics capture the observable behaviour of λ \lambda -terms; Böhm Trees and Taylor Expansion are its two central paradigms, related by the Commutation Theorem. While well understood in Call-by-Name (CbN), these notions were only recently developed for Call-by-Value (CbV), motivating the search for a unified approximation framework.

arxiv-2601-12829.description: Abstract Background Total photoabsorption cross sections are important for an understanding of nuclear structure and for many applications, in particular in astrophysics. The majority of data stems from measurements of neutron emission after photoexcitation, which in heavy nuclei represent a good approximation to the total cross sections.

pmc-10697052.title: Humor-Based Messaging in Testicular Cancer Awareness Campaigns: A Comparative Critical Review
pmc-10697052.creator: Michael J Rovito, Keri K Allen, Andres G Perez, Freddy Albaladejo, Mike Craycraft
pmc-10697052.description: Extensive research showcases the extent and efficacy of humor-based messaging in general health promotion. However, the work describing humor’s use within testicular cancer (TC) awareness is less developed. The aim of this comparative critical review was to determine the impact of using humor-based messaging in TC awareness campaigns to achieve a baseline assessment from which future research can be modeled.

pmc-11587462.title: Sensitization and Habituation of Hyper-Excitation to Constant Presentation of Pattern-Glare Stimuli
pmc-11587462.creator: Thomas Jefferis, Cihan Dogan, Claire E. Miller, Maria Karathanou, Austyn Tempesta, Andrew J. Schofield, Howard Bowman
pmc-11587462.description: Background/Objectives: Pattern glare, associated with cortical hyperexcitability, induces visual distortions and discomfort, particularly in individuals susceptible to migraines or epilepsy. While previous research has primarily focused on transient EEG responses to patterned stimuli, this study aims to investigate how continuous presentation of pattern-glare stimuli affects neural adaptation over both fine (seconds) and coarse (entire experiment) temporal scales.

pmc-12442814.title: Unsupervised Clustering of Vertebral Hounsfield Units in Opportunistic Chest CT for Stratifying Bone Mass Subtypes in a 2 Years’ Period
pmc-12442814.creator: Hui Yang, Jiang Li, Xiuzhu Zheng, Datian Su, Cheng Jia, Jian Qin, Quan Zhang
pmc-12442814.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThere is an urgent need for a convenient and incidental method to assess the bone health status of the population, especially in primary-level hospitals lacking specialized bone density testing equipment. This study aims to investigate the association between multiple vertebral Hounsfield Unit (HU) value clusters and bone mass subtypes using an unsupervised learning approach, providing a practical tool for incidental osteoporosis screening in clinical settings.Materials and MethodsThis retrospective study included subjects who underwent chest CT and quantitative CT (QCT) from January 2023

pmc-12594858.creator: Kalil Warren, Chandler Nichols, Dawson Petersen, Valerie L Shalin, Amit Almor
pmc-12594858.description: uality of moral reasoning in human-generated and LLM-generated responses to moral questions. The prompts used to elicit the responses asked whether and why certain actions were morally wrong or acceptable.

pmc-12617133.description: Issue/problemAlthough schools and educational institutions are supposed to be safe learning and working environments the increase of safety incidents, especially physical, emotional, and sexual violence, bullying and harassment as well as disasters and injuries show that new understanding about safety culture is needed.

pmc-12683064.title: Lung isolation using retrograde intrabronchial Fogarty catheter: Experience from 35 cases
pmc-12683064.creator: Najim Hanna Hirmiz, Abdulsalam Yaseen Taha
pmc-12683064.description: ObjectivesOne-lung ventilation is vital in thoracic surgery to improve exposure and protect the contralateral lung. Standard techniques using double-lumen tubes or bronchial blockers require specialized equipment and training, which are often unavailable in emergencies, pediatric cases, or low-resource settings. Retrograde intraoperative insertion of a Fogarty catheter into an open bronchus is a seldom-reported alternative, with only 1 previous case documented.

pmc-12718441.title: Helicosphaera carteri (Prymnesiophyceae) under high carbon dioxide: An experimental study
pmc-12718441.creator: Stefania Bianco, Manuela Bordiga, Gerald Langer, Patrizia Ziveri, Federica Cerino, Federica Relitti, Vincenzo Alessandro Laudicella, Andrea Di Giulio, Claudia Lupi
pmc-12718441.description: The coccolithophore Helicosphaera carteri is an understudied, yet ecologically and biogeochemically important, marine calcifier. Hence, its response to ocean acidification has implications for ecosystem function and the marine carbon cycle. Here we employed dilute batch cultures featuring a coupled C‐system manipulation (295, 444, and 600 μatm CO2) to analyze the response of H.

pmc-12785528.title: Prescribing Patterns and Adverse Effects of Semaglutide: A Real-World Comparative Evaluation
pmc-12785528.creator: Abigail Whorton, Samira Osman, Jaspal Johal, Sarah Baig, Alan M. Jones, Zahraa Jalal
pmc-12785528.description: Background: Semaglutide is a Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and weight management. While its clinical benefits are well established, concerns have emerged over off-label use, underreporting of adverse drug reactions (ADRs), and prescribing disparities.

pmc-12936249.title: Stress Characteristics and Their Associations With Pain Intensity: An Ecological Momentary Assessment Study
pmc-12936249.creator: Karen Ghoussoub, Mael Gagnon‐Mailhot, Élise Develay, Pierre Rainville, Sonia Lupien, Lise Dassieu, Mathieu Roy, Étienne Vachon‐Presseau, M. Gabrielle Pagé
pmc-12936249.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to understand the associations between stress intensity, characteristics that trigger a physiological stress responses (Sense of lack of control, social evaluative Threat, Unpredictability, Novelty; STUN) and the experience of momentary pain intensity and its variability among adults living with chronic low back pain.

pmc-13273004.title: Enhanced Pb2+ adsorption performance of coal gangue modified by Bacillus megaterium (CG-W)
pmc-13273004.creator: Wang Li, Chenxi Shao, Xiaobo Zhu, Xueyu Bai, Shenxu Bao
pmc-13273004.description: Coal gangue is the main solid waste generated during the mining and processing of coal. Its resource utilization is a pressing issue that needs to be addressed urgently at present. Meanwhile, lead pollution has become one of the major environmental challenges faced by global soil and water bodies.

pmc-13297727.title: Anomalous Left Coronary Artery from the Pulmonary Artery: Cinematic Volume Rendering Technique for Enhanced Anatomic Visualization
pmc-13297727.creator: Shuo Liang, Kun Zhang, Hong Zhang
pmc-13297727.description: Anomalous left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery (ALCAPA) is a rare congenital anomaly with exceptional survival into adulthood. We present a 66-year-old woman with chest and back pain in whom ALCAPA was diagnosed using coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) with curved planar reformation and cinematic volume rendering technique (cVRT).

pmc-13374433.title: Renal injury and hypocalcaemia in newborns with birth asphyxia at a tertiary care centre: a prospective observational study
pmc-13374433.creator: Subhash Chandra Tard, Gajanand Singh Tanwar, Pramod Kumar Berwal
pmc-13374433.description: BackgroundBirth asphyxia, also known as perinatal hypoxia-ischaemia, is a significant cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality. It occurs when a newborn experiences insufficient oxygen during birth, potentially leading to multisystem injury including renal dysfunction and disruption of calcium homeostasis. Understanding the impact of birth asphyxia on renal function and serum calcium levels is critical for early detection and timely intervention.

pmc-13478379.title: A labile sulfur ligand in a three-cysteine-coordinated [2Fe−2S] cluster mediates sulfide sensing in NreB
pmc-13478379.creator: Chao Tang, Yuemeng Shen, Jingyao Qu, Lu Yu, Honglei Liu, Huaiwei Liu, Luying Xun, Yongzhen Xia
pmc-13478379.description: Iron-sulfur clusters are versatile protein cofactors involved in diverse biological processes, but their role in hydrogen sulfide/hydrosulfide (H2S/HS-) sensing remains largely unexplored. Here, we report that the Bacillus licheniformis sensor kinase NreB contains an unusual [2Fe-2S] cluster within its PAS domain. A 1.

pmc-13689834.title: Evaluation of organ visualisation and biopsy quality during left-sided coelioscopy in rescued Northern boobooks (Ninox japonica)
pmc-13689834.creator: Jang-Hee Han, So-Eun Ryu, Hyeok-Won An, Hyeok Jin Son, Seung Yoon Ahn, Jinyoung Kim, Jun Won Park, Seong-Chan Yeon
pmc-13689834.description: Intra-vital diagnosis in wild raptors can be confounded by their stoic nature, often leading to cryptic morbidity. While coelioscopy offers a minimally invasive alternative, its performance regarding diagnostic utility and biopsy quality remains uncharacterised in small owls. Eight Northern boobooks (Ninox japonica) underwent diagnostic coelioscopy using a 2.7 mm rigid endoscope.
